title: A backup exists. Has restoration been checked?
goal: Prepare an upgrade with automated tests, measured evidence and verified recovery.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P11. Preserve accepted work, sources and a DT; distinguish common-module and application roles.

sections.title: Where the question starts
paragraphs: The archive was created without an error. Can it restore the same customers and requests? Restore the training infobase at another path, compare references and fields, then change only the copy. File creation and successful restoration are two different observations.

sections.title: Preserve accepted work and choose your own copy
paragraphs: First preserve accepted P11 work, sources and a DT. Run P12 in a separate new file infobase containing only the 12 invented requests. Initially transfer your metadata into a new empty infobase; never load a CF over prior work. Create the 30,45,15,0,60,20,25,35,40,50,55,65 dataset exactly once. If records already exist, do not repeat seed.

Data functions belong to own server common module УчебнаяИтоговая: Server/Server call enabled; Client/Global/Privileged disabled. Приложение.bsl belongs to the separate client application module. Preserve the prior handler and remove only the added call after the experiment. Neither delete nor duplicate old definitions.

sections.title: What a finished submission contains
paragraphs: Creating an archive is only one step. Another person must be able to identify the delivered source, the platform version used, the observed results and the procedure for restoring the accepted state. Retain source, platform version, a test table and a separate DT backup. A prepared candidate and a published release are different states.

The control set contains 12 of your own requests with durations 30, 45, 15, 0, 60, 20, 25, 35, 40, 50, 55 and 65 minutes. Their total is 440 minutes. Odd positions belong to customer A and total 225; even positions belong to customer B and total 215. Here “12/440” means 12 documents and 440 minutes, not division. Record actual numbers and references; they may differ from the reference labels F1–F12.

sections.title: Complete source of the worked action
paragraphs: Before dumping, 12 documents and 440 minutes were recorded. After an actual DT restore, all eight fields in every row matched: number, document reference, customer and service references, date, status, minutes and comment. Changing the copy’s last duration from 65 to 80 produces 455, retained after reopening. The original remains 440.
Files below belong to their respective modules. Source, loading and observation after running are separate stages.

sections.title: Walk through the action and result
paragraphs: Before dumping, 12 documents and 440 minutes were recorded. After an actual DT restore, all eight fields in every row matched: number, document reference, customer and service references, date, status, minutes and comment. Changing the copy’s last duration from 65 to 80 produces 455, retained after reopening. The original remains 440.
Read every result label and identify the specific comparison it establishes. A successful run by itself does not establish the requirement.
The result below is a labelled summary of distinct experiment stages, not one command’s stdout. Each stage has its own source, action and observation.

2. Close the client and dump a DT.
3. Create another empty infobase and restore the DT.
4. Compare all 12 rows and eight fields.
5. Only in the copy: F00000012, 65 → 80 minutes.
6. Reopen the copy: 455 minutes.
7. Open the original separately: 440 minutes.

sections.title: How to check preservation
paragraphs: Compare document membership first: numbers, references, customer, service, date, status, comment and duration. Then add the durations independently. A total alone is insufficient: losing one 30-minute request and adding another 30-minute request preserves the total while changing the document set.

Create a table with check, expected result, observed result and status columns. Include separate cases for valid input, invalid-input rejection, reopening and restoration. Mark PASS only after observing the outcome. Use NOT RUN with a reason for an unperformed step. A syntax check does not replace execution.

sections.title: Your prediction before running
paragraphs: The restored total matches 440. Can references and record membership be skipped?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. Other documents or values moved between customers can also yield 12/440. Define the expectation for every record and field. Reopening is another persistence check; compare the copy and original at their distinct actual paths.

sections.title: How to test restoration and a change
paragraphs: Close Enterprise before dumping the DT. Restore the file into a new empty infobase at a different path and verify all 12 documents and their fields. This tests whether the backup is usable. Merely having a DT file does not prove that its contents can be restored and opened.

Only in the restored copy, change the final duration from 65 to 80 minutes: the total should become 455. Close and reopen Enterprise and verify 455 again. Open the source infobase separately and verify it still contains 440. For a request whose saved duration is 30, try 1441: the existing validation should refuse it and leave the saved 30 unchanged. Keep these experiments out of the accepted source infobase.

sections.title: How state changes
paragraphs: Only the restored copy moves through 440 → 455 → 475. The original has another path and stays at 440. Each transition compares references and fields separately from the total.

sections.title: When a plausible result is wrong
paragraphs: Only minutes are compared and newly generated data is accepted as a restore. Or the expected 440 is changed to 455, hiding an altered original. Keep prior snapshots; a changed scenario gets another check row rather than a rewritten old PASS.

sections.title: How to deliver and return to an accepted state
paragraphs: Describe the package version, source SHA, actual platform version, test results and limitations. The SHA links the record to exact source. Preserve the cause of a failed attempt and the subsequent regression result instead of rewriting an earlier record.

A full CF load can replace a customized configuration. Test normal updates through comparison and merging in a separate copy first. Restore an accepted state into another directory and retain the failed copy for investigation. Returning old source does not guarantee reversal of changed data; identify the saved state to which recovery was actually verified.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Continue only the restored experimental copy with 455 minutes. Change the first request from 30 to 50 minutes while the last stays 80. Expect 475 minutes and the same 12 references. Compare every field: only the first request’s minutes may differ. Reopen the copy and separately confirm 440 in the original. Do not restore a DT over your sole work.
Preserve your attempt and prediction first. The reference is available on request and does not replace your work.
